svg.aria-label: Proof on the page. Every finding is outlined on the page it came from and graded exact, strong, approximate or unlocated. A finding that can't be found on the page can't become a deadline until a person confirms it.

g.text: You are hereby directed to explain the
discrepancies and pay the tax of
days of receipt of this notice.
WHAT THE NOTICE SAYS, GRADED AGAINST THE PAGE
Every finding is outlined on the page it came from.
If it can't be found there, it can't become a deadline.
